## Example 6.6 {#iv6-example-6-6 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson .angles-lesson .a-mc}

```{=html}
<p>Which of the following vectors is perpendicular to <span data-math="3\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{j}-5\underset{\sim}{k}"></span>?</p><div class="a-options"><div><strong>1.</strong><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="-\underset{\sim}{i}-\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div></div><div><strong>2.</strong><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{i}+\underset{\sim}{j}-\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div></div><div><strong>3.</strong><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="-2\underset{\sim}{i}+3\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div></div><div><strong>4.</strong><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="3\underset{\sim}{i}-2\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div></div></div><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="a-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="a-cols "><div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{1: }3(-1)+2(-1)-5(1)=-10"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{2: }3(1)+2(1)-5(-1)=10"></span></div></div><div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{3: }3(-2)+2(3)-5(1)=-5"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{4: }3(3)+2(-2)-5(1)=0"></span></div></div></div><p><strong>Answer: 4</strong> — the scalar product is zero.</p></div></div><p class="a-source">HSC 2024 Extension 2, Question 1 · 1 mark</p>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Section 6 · p. 45</div>

::: notes
Original choices A–D appear as 1–4 in the same order; correct source answer D, screen choice 4. This is an ordinary worked example, explicitly not a hinge: no timer, voting routine or quiz controls. Each of choices 1–3 has non-zero scalar product; choice 4 is perpendicular.
:::
